description: This file defines an 'AsyncLock' class implementing an asynchronous mutual exclusion mechanism using 'SemaphoreSlim'. It supports the 'using' pattern for scoped locking and provides an internal 'LockReleaser' class for releasing the lock. The class enables async-friendly lock acquisition with proper resource cleanup, mimicking traditional mutex semantics within an async context.

classes.name: AsyncLock
classes.description: An asynchronous mutual exclusion mechanism providing async-compatible lock semantics, supporting scope via 'using'.

classes.name: AsyncLock.LockReleaser
classes.description: A disposable helper class for releasing the lock in the scope of a 'using' statement.

methods.name: AsyncLock()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the semaphore with a count of one.

methods.name: LockAsync()
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires the lock, returning a disposable object to release it.

methods.name: LockReleaser.Dispose()
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, releasing the lock asynchronously.
